tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Signature of the Complement of a Non-Null Line]

↗ lem:adapted-orthonormal-basis-line ↗ lem:orthonormal-basis-orthogonal-complement ↗ lem:orthogonal-complement-non-null-line-nondegenerate ↗ prop:sylvesters-law-inertia

Let $(V,q)$ have signature $(r,s)$, let $\langle x,x\rangle \ne 0$, and let $(r',s')$ be the signature of $\operatorname {span}(x)^\perp $, which is nondegenerate by Lemma 17. If $\langle x,x\rangle >0$, then $r'+1=r$ and $s'=s$; if $\langle x,x\rangle <0$, then $r'=r$ and $s'+1=s$.
Proof

↗ lem:adapted-orthonormal-basis-line ↗ lem:orthonormal-basis-orthogonal-complement ↗ prop:sylvesters-law-inertia \sketch Choose an orthonormal basis with $b_1$ spanning $x$ by Lemma 17; its tail is an orthonormal basis of the complement by Lemma 17. Sylvester’s law counts signs, and $b_1=cx$ has the sign of $x$.

□
